title: Shabdsanchay Journal
tagline: Peer-reviewed multidisciplinary research journal website and publishing portal.
shortDescription: Website design, logo identity, and research paper submission platform for Shabdsanchay Journal under Painganga Publication.
description: Shabdsanchay is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed research journal published by Painganga Publication. Developed full website on Wix Studio, logo design, social presence, and paper submission platform as the first professional client project.

caseStudy.problem: Painganga Publication required a dedicated digital portal for Shabdsanchay Journal to accept researcher submissions, showcase published issues, and establish digital presence.
caseStudy.solution: Designed and delivered the official Shabdsanchay website using Wix Studio, designed the publication logo and brand assets, and established official social media channels.
features: Custom research journal website built on Wix Studio
Digital paper submission workflow for researchers
Published issues catalog and article access portal
Original logo design aligned with academic branding
Social media setup and digital presence management
Ongoing website maintenance and issue publication updates
caseStudy.challenges: Translating academic publication guidelines into an intuitive user journey on Wix Studio while delivering my first commercial client engagement.
caseStudy.outcome: Successfully delivered my first professional client project on schedule, providing Painganga Publication with an operational journal portal.
caseStudy.learnings: End-to-end client stakeholder communication, rapid prototyping with Wix Studio, visual brand alignment, and production maintenance.
